title: Pre-registered test: does the D1 trend-align fetch add entry latency? (08/12/16Z closes, 2026-11-15)
note: PRE-REGISTERED by the manager 2026-11-15 04:25Z, before the data exists. WINDOW: the 08:00Z, 12:00Z and 16:00Z closes. METRIC: per leg, package latency = created_at minus bar close (first 15 min of a bar), pooling ALL post-deploy packages (after the 23:20:55Z deploy of #26149) against that leg's prior-7d median (7 days before the deploy). TRIP if (a) 2 or more legs, each with n >= 3 post-deploy packages, show a median rise of more than 30 s, or (b) ANY post-deploy package exceeds 300 s. ON TRIP: build D1 null-on-path for non-daily legs (keep the LEG label; the ESTIMATED backfill covers D1) as a Tier-2 hold to the manager. OTHERWISE: close it as kept, with the numbers. ALSO: report the Bybit 10006 hit count per close (00-06 min). Read scheduled 16:20Z. Context: the 04:00Z rule was not met (TREND-ALIGN-LABEL-ALL); the 00Z disclosure (eth_4h 171 s vs 18.6, xrp legs +40 s, small n) motivated this test. 2026-11-15 16:21Z READ (AM-OPS), rule unchanged: TRIPPED. (a) Median latency rise >30 s on legs with n>=3: ml_entry +73.7 s (pre n=49 med 158.8 -> post n=8 med 232.6), ml_entry_v2 +32.4 s (pre 5 -> post 6), xrp_pullback_2h +127.7 s (pre 2 -> post 3). (b) Post-deploy packages >300 s: ml_entry 359.5, ml_entry_v2 405.5, xrp_pullback_2h 414.1, sol_pullback_2h 849.7. Population: 3,234 unique order packages; latency = created_at mod bar seconds, first 900 s of a bar only; post window 2026-11-14 23:20:55Z to 2026-11-15 16:00Z vs each leg's 7 days before. Confound (reported, not applied): sol_pullback_2h re-dispatches every minute since the 11-12 gate removals. Bybit 10006 lines in the first 15 min after each close: 08Z 5, 12Z 4, 16Z 3. On-trip build: #26367 (Tier 2 hold, RESTART), D1 null-on-path (d1_off_path) for non-daily legs, LEG kept. Closing observation: after deploy, non-daily legs' median latency back within 30 s of the prior-7d median over the next 3 closes, and their packages carry D1 missing_reason=d1_off_path. 16:30Z READ by manager 15a, rule applied AS REGISTERED: TRIP. Method: GET /api/bot/order-packages?include_paper=true&since=2026-11-07T23:20:55Z&strategy=<leg> per leg in config/strategies.yaml (limit 200/leg, no leg hit the cap). Latency = createdAt - (signalLogic.entry_time + timeframe), kept if 0..900s; pre = 7d before the 2026-11-14 23:20:55Z deploy, post = after it. Population: only packages carrying entry_time + a parseable timeframe; 8 legs had post packages. (a) MET: 3 legs with post n>=3 and median rise >30s: ml_entry pre n49 med 158.8 -> post n8 med 232.6 (+73.7s); ml_entry_v2 pre n5 182.0 -> post n6 214.4 (+32.4s); xrp_pullback_2h pre n2 79.0 -> post n4 209.9 (+130.9s). Others post n<3: trend_donchian_eth_4h 18.6 -> 171.4 (n1), xrp_4h +39.9 (n1), xrp_adx25 +41.8 (n1), ada_pullback_2h +1.0 (n1). (b) MET: 4 post packages >300s, ALL at the 08:00Z close: ml_entry 08:05:45 346s and 08:05:59 359s, ml_entry_v2 08:06:45 406s, xrp_pullback_2h 08:06:54 414s. Disclosed confounds (NOT used to override the rule): live VM CPU saturation (LIVE-VM-CPU-SATURATION-1112), trader restarts 15:05/15:41Z, small pre n on several legs. Bybit 10006 hit count per close: NOT READ (needs the trader log; left to the build lane). ON TRIP per the registration: build D1 null-on-path for non-daily legs (keep the LEG label; ESTIMATED backfill covers D1) as a Tier-2 HOLD to the manager. Assigned to AM-OPS after the prop ETH close is confirmed. 16:52Z on-trip build #26367 MERGED (45d38872) in the batch with #26363/#26353. Closes when the 20:00Z close shows non-daily legs' package latency back near their prior-7d medians and D1 reads d1_off_path on non-daily packages. 20:16Z PARTIAL OBSERVATION after the #26367 deploy (16:55:36Z restart). Population: all 95 order packages created 16:55:36Z..20:15Z (include_paper). (1) D1 off-path CONFIRMED: 95/95 non-daily packages carry meta.trend_align.D1.missing_reason=d1_off_path. (2) Latency: 0 post-fix packages over 300s. Only 1 package in the first-15-min-of-bar window: xrp_pullback_2h 77.5s, vs its prior-7d median 79.0s and the tripped post-deploy median 209.9s, i.e. back to baseline. ml_entry / ml_entry_v2 had no in-window package yet (n=0). Closes when ml_entry + ml_entry_v2 show >=3 in-window packages each near their prior-7d medians (158.8s / 182.0s); re-read at the 11-16 00:00Z and 04:00Z closes. 2026-11-16 00:25Z manager: AM-OPS rotated to AM-OPS-2 (session_01AFoLuKdqv7sRrnLSFhbH4a). To save usage, there will be one closing read at 04:25Z covering the 20Z/00Z/04Z closes (scheduled into AM-OPS-2), instead of separate 00Z and 04Z reads. 2026-11-16 04:27Z CLOSING READ (AM-OPS-2), manager method (order-packages include_paper, latency = createdAt - (entry_time + timeframe), kept 0..900 s; pre = 7d before the 2026-11-14 23:20:55Z deploy; post = from the #26367 deploy 2026-11-15 16:55:36Z). Reproduced the baselines: ml_entry pre n49 med 158.8, xrp_pullback_2h pre n2 med 79.0. POPULATION: 62 legs in config, 127 in-window packages pre+post; 9 post-fix in-window. RESULT: ml_entry post n7 med 217.1 s (+58.3 s vs 158.8; values 00Z close 174/219/237, 04Z close 161/169/217/232; max 237, none > 300) -> NOT within 30 s. ml_entry_v2: 0 post-fix packages (no n). xrp_pullback_2h post n1 77.5 s (vs 79.0); ict_scalp_xrp_5m post n1 37.1 s (no pre). D1: 9/9 post-fix in-window non-daily packages carry d1_off_path (20:00Z read had 95/95 of all post-fix packages). Rule (every n>=3 leg within 30 s, ml_entry and ml_entry_v2 included) is not met: ml_entry +58 s, ml_entry_v2 has no data. Confounds, reported not applied: per-close latency rises with the symbol's place in the serial package order (ETH first 161-174 s, then SOL/XRP/ADA 169-237 s), so the median depends on how many symbols fire per close; the 20:00Z close produced no ml_entry package. Row stays in_flight. 2026-11-16 04:30Z manager: AM-OPS-2's closing read says the registered rule is NOT met (ml_entry +58.3 s, n=7). D1 IS off the path (104/104). The residual latency is attributed to a separate cause and filed as ML-ENTRY-LATENCY-SERIAL. This row stays in_flight; close it as done-for-D1 at the next manager review, with the residual carried by the new row.
